description: This file defines an Express.js router for analytics-related endpoints in a backend service. It includes routes for health checks, cost-by-agent analytics, and user activity trends, protected by authentication and tenant verification middleware.

methods.name: HEAD /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Health endpoint that returns 204 to indicate service reachability for the LLM cost-by-agent feature.

methods.name: OPTIONS /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Preflight endpoint that responds with status 204 to support CORS.

methods.name: GET /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Main endpoint to retrieve LLM cost data by agent, protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /users/active-trend
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch user activity trend data, protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /users/new-over-time
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve new user metrics over time, protected by authentication and tenant verification.
